description: The corpus's own suite fields, added to the core by import exactly as a workspace adds its own (DEC-S10): requires on a suite, case or step, and cluster and target on defaults and cases. The validate corpus checks that extension fields are accepted where declared and refused elsewhere.

requires.description: What a case or step needs from the environment it runs against. Fixture field: the corpus checks that it validates where declared.

storage.description: The storage the lab was built with.

features.description: Plan features that must be on.

family.description: The lab's image family. A plan without one is windowsServer.

identity.description: The lab's identity mode. A plan without one is domain.

rollbackPoint.description: true: the lab holds at least one verified, restorable rollback point.
